name: Robert Hunt
role: Brother of L. C. Hunt, KC ranch
mentions: While L. C. and Robert Hunt were loading a bunch of KC cattle at Dickinson, Tuesday, they received word from their sister Bessie at Fort Union, New Mexico, that their father had died there on…
…hought best to bury the remains of his father at Fort Union, and have them removed next winter to Washington. Robert Hunt who went to Detroit from New Mexico, will return in about a week.
